content:
A wonderful day of cooking, friendship, and celebration! 🥘💛

Today, Peace Academy of West Texas hosted a cooking class at the (@wtxfoodbank West Texas Food Bank. Together, we prepared delicious maklube and baklava, enjoyed lovely conversations, and shared the meal we made!

We also had the joy of celebrating the birthdays of Kelys H and Leslie Alvarez together. Happy birthday to both of you! Thank you for sharing your special day with us! 🎂🎉

A warm thank-you to our instructors, volunteers, and everyone who joined us, and to the West Texas Food Bank for welcoming us into their kitchen.

#PeaceAcademyOfWestTexas #WestTexasFoodBank #CookingClass #FoodAndFriendship
